```{r}
# ============================================================
# Exploratory fungal and viral functional potential analysis
# Vaginal WGS microbiome and spontaneous preterm birth
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
})

# -----------------------------
# Project paths
# -----------------------------

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"
data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")
metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_function_file <- file.path(data_dir, "fungal_function_wide.csv")
viral_function_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "viral_geneProduct_matrix.csv")

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "exploratory_functional_potential")
fig_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "exploratory_functional_potential")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Analysis settings
# -----------------------------

min_prevalence <- 0.05
top_n <- 20
pseudocount <- 1e-6

outcome_colours <- c(
  "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
  "sPTB 34–37" = "#9467bd",
  "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
)

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------

read_metadata <- function(metadata_file_tsv) {
  meta <- read.delim(
    metadata_file_tsv,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"
  meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)
  
  meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      birth_group = case_when(
        outcome == "TERM" ~ "TERM",
        outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "no" ~ "sPTB 34–37",
        outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      birth_group = factor(
        birth_group,
        levels = c("TERM", "sPTB 34–37", "sPTB <34")
      )
    )
  
  return(meta)
}

clean_numeric_matrix <- function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  mat <- as.matrix(df)
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  return(mat)
}

align_metadata_to_matrix <- function(mat, meta) {
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  meta_aligned <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  if (!all(meta_aligned$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_aligned) <- meta_aligned$reads_ID
  
  return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta_aligned))
}

filter_by_prevalence <- function(mat, min_prevalence = 0.05) {
  prevalence <- colMeans(mat > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep <- prevalence >= min_prevalence
  
  message("Features before filtering: ", ncol(mat))
  message("Features after filtering: ", sum(keep))
  
  filtered <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  return(filtered)
}

convert_to_relative_abundance <- function(mat) {
  row_totals <- rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat_rel <- sweep(mat, 1, row_totals, "/")
  mat_rel[is.na(mat_rel)] <- 0
  return(mat_rel)
}

remove_zero_variance_features <- function(mat) {
  feature_sd <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat[, feature_sd > 0, drop = FALSE]
}

make_top_feature_table <- function(mat_counts, mat_rel, domain, output_prefix) {
  top_table <- data.frame(
    feature = colnames(mat_counts),
    total_counts = colSums(mat_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_n = colSums(mat_counts > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_percent = round(100 * colMeans(mat_counts > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_relative_abundance = colMeans(mat_rel, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_counts)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(domain = domain) %>%
    select(domain, everything())
  
  write.csv(
    top_table,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_top_", top_n, "_features.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(top_table)
}

make_pca_plot <- function(mat_rel, meta, domain, output_prefix) {
  mat_log <- log10(mat_rel + pseudocount)
  mat_log <- remove_zero_variance_features(mat_log)
  
  pca <- prcomp(mat_log, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)
  
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    reads_ID = rownames(mat_log),
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2]
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      meta %>% select(reads_ID, sample_label, outcome, sPTB34, birth_group),
      by = "reads_ID"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = birth_group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = outcome_colours, na.value = "grey70") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste(domain, "functional potential PCA"),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
      colour = "Outcome group"
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PCA.png")),
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  write.csv(
    pca_df,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PCA_coordinates.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(p)
}

run_top_feature_wilcoxon <- function(mat_rel, meta, top_features, output_prefix) {
  results <- lapply(top_features, function(feature) {
    dat <- data.frame(
      abundance = mat_rel[, feature],
      outcome = meta$outcome,
      sPTB34 = meta$sPTB34
    )
    
    term_sptb_p <- wilcox.test(
      abundance ~ outcome,
      data = dat %>% filter(outcome %in% c("TERM", "sPTB")),
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
    
    sptb34_p <- wilcox.test(
      abundance ~ sPTB34,
      data = dat %>% filter(!is.na(sPTB34)),
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
    
    data.frame(
      feature = feature,
      median_TERM = median(dat$abundance[dat$outcome == "TERM"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_sPTB = median(dat$abundance[dat$outcome == "sPTB"], na.rm = TRUE),
      term_vs_sptb_p = term_sptb_p,
      sptb34_yes_no_p = sptb34_p
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(
      term_vs_sptb_q = p.adjust(term_vs_sptb_p, method = "BH"),
      sptb34_yes_no_q = p.adjust(sptb34_yes_no_p, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(term_vs_sptb_p)
  
  write.csv(
    results,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_top_feature_wilcoxon.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(results)
}

make_top_feature_heatmap <- function(mat_rel, meta, top_features, output_prefix) {
  
  heat_mat <- mat_rel[, top_features, drop = FALSE]
  heat_mat <- log10(heat_mat + pseudocount)
  
  row_annotation <- data.frame(
    Delivery_group = meta$birth_group
  )
  rownames(row_annotation) <- rownames(meta)
  
  annotation_colours <- list(
    Delivery_group = c(
      "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
      "sPTB 34–37" = "#9467bd",
      "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
    )
  )
  
  heatmap_colours <- colorRampPalette(
    c("#440154", "#31688e", "#35b779", "#fde725")
  )(100)
  
  pheatmap(
    heat_mat,
    color = heatmap_colours,
    annotation_row = row_annotation,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colours,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    scale = "column",
    fontsize_col = 8,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    angle_col = 90,
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0(
      ifelse(output_prefix == "fungal", "Fungal", "Viral/phage"),
      " functional potential — Top ",
      length(top_features),
      " features"
    ),
    filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_top_features_heatmap.png")),
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Load metadata
# ============================================================

meta <- read_metadata(metadata_file_tsv)

# ============================================================
# Fungal functional potential analysis
# Input format:
# rows = samples
# columns = fungal protein features
# values = read counts
# ============================================================

fungal_raw <- read.csv(
  fungal_function_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

fungal_mat <- clean_numeric_matrix(fungal_raw)

fungal_aligned <- align_metadata_to_matrix(fungal_mat, meta)
fungal_mat <- fungal_aligned$mat
fungal_meta <- fungal_aligned$meta

fungal_filtered <- filter_by_prevalence(fungal_mat, min_prevalence)
fungal_rel <- convert_to_relative_abundance(fungal_filtered)

fungal_top <- make_top_feature_table(
  mat_counts = fungal_filtered,
  mat_rel = fungal_rel,
  domain = "Fungal",
  output_prefix = "fungal"
)

fungal_pca <- make_pca_plot(
  mat_rel = fungal_rel,
  meta = fungal_meta,
  domain = "Fungal",
  output_prefix = "fungal"
)

fungal_wilcox <- run_top_feature_wilcoxon(
  mat_rel = fungal_rel,
  meta = fungal_meta,
  top_features = fungal_top$feature,
  output_prefix = "fungal"
)

make_top_feature_heatmap(
  mat_rel = fungal_rel,
  meta = fungal_meta,
  top_features = fungal_top$feature,
  output_prefix = "fungal"
)

# ============================================================
# Viral/phage functional potential analysis
# Input expected:
# rows = samples OR gene products
# columns = gene products OR samples
# The script checks orientation automatically.
# ============================================================

viral_raw <- read.csv(
  viral_function_file,
  check.names = FALSE
)

first_col <- viral_raw[[1]]
viral_body <- viral_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

rownames(viral_body) <- first_col
viral_body <- clean_numeric_matrix(viral_body)

sample_overlap_rows <- sum(sub("_1$", "", rownames(viral_body)) %in% meta$reads_ID)
sample_overlap_cols <- sum(sub("_1$", "", colnames(viral_body)) %in% meta$reads_ID)

if (sample_overlap_rows >= sample_overlap_cols) {
  viral_mat <- viral_body
} else {
  viral_mat <- t(viral_body)
}

viral_aligned <- align_metadata_to_matrix(viral_mat, meta)
viral_mat <- viral_aligned$mat
viral_meta <- viral_aligned$meta

viral_filtered <- filter_by_prevalence(viral_mat, min_prevalence)
viral_rel <- convert_to_relative_abundance(viral_filtered)

viral_top <- make_top_feature_table(
  mat_counts = viral_filtered,
  mat_rel = viral_rel,
  domain = "Viral/phage",
  output_prefix = "viral"
)

viral_pca <- make_pca_plot(
  mat_rel = viral_rel,
  meta = viral_meta,
  domain = "Viral/phage",
  output_prefix = "viral"
)

viral_wilcox <- run_top_feature_wilcoxon(
  mat_rel = viral_rel,
  meta = viral_meta,
  top_features = viral_top$feature,
  output_prefix = "viral"
)

make_top_feature_heatmap(
  mat_rel = viral_rel,
  meta = viral_meta,
  top_features = viral_top$feature,
  output_prefix = "viral"
)

# ============================================================
# Combined output
# ============================================================

combined_top_features <- bind_rows(fungal_top, viral_top)

write.csv(
  combined_top_features,
  file.path(out_dir, "combined_top_functional_features.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

combined_wilcox <- bind_rows(
  fungal_wilcox %>% mutate(domain = "Fungal"),
  viral_wilcox %>% mutate(domain = "Viral/phage")
) %>%
  select(domain, everything())

write.csv(
  combined_wilcox,
  file.path(out_dir, "combined_top_feature_wilcoxon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Exploratory functional potential analysis complete.")
message("Results saved to: ", out_dir)
message("Figures saved to: ", fig_dir)
```
